questions.question: What does Isaiah 62 say about Zion's future name?
options: She will be called City of Truth, and her land Holy
She will be called the Mother of all Nations, and her land Free
She will be called My Delight Is in Her, and her land Married
She will be called Forsaken, and her land Desolate
questions.answer: She will be called My Delight Is in Her, and her land Married

questions.question: What does the prophet vow not to do for Zion's sake in Isaiah 62?
options: To gather home all of her exiles from the distant lands
To lead out all of her armies against the surrounding nations
To rebuild all of her broken walls with his very own hands
To keep silent until her righteousness shines out
questions.answer: To keep silent until her righteousness shines out

questions.question: Isaiah 62 says God rejoices over Zion as a bridegroom rejoices over his bride.
You shall no more be termed Forsaken; you shall be called My _____ Is in Her.
As the bridegroom rejoices over the bride, so shall your God rejoice over _____.
